source.name: Unbox Health
source.method: Independent lab tests, up to 3 NABL-accredited labs per product

fields.unit: what one dose unit is: capsule, tablet or serving
fields.claimed_mg / lab_mg: elemental magnesium per unit; label vs lab-tested
fields.lead, arsenic, cadmium, mercury: ppm as tested; 0 = below detection limit; null = not retrieved
fields.nts / las: Unbox Health non-toxicity and label-accuracy scores out of 10
fields.valid_till_iso: date the rating lapses (approximate dates use the end of the period); null = unknown, use status
fields.price / pack: ₹ and units per pack; null where no price was recorded

products.name: Magnesium Glycinate
products.notes: Lab found ~39% more than the label, so one capsule may hold ~168 mg. The tested batch is old: check the expiry on the lot you get.

products.name: Magnesium Glycinate
products.notes: Same product and lab data as the 120-capsule pack.

products.name: Magnesium Glycinate
products.notes: Freshest active rating (Jan 2026). One tablet is ~283 mg, already a full daily dose; two a day would pass the 350 mg supplement ceiling.

products.name: Magnesium Glycinate Men
products.notes: Test was requested by the community, the strongest independence signal here. One capsule (~240 mg) is a full daily dose.

products.name: Magnesium Bisglycinate
products.notes: True bisglycinate and the closest to its label in the 220 mg group. Lead (0.78 ppm) is within FSSAI limits but second-highest among active ratings.

products.name: Chelated Magnesium Glycinate
products.notes: Perfect scores, but its lead (1.0 ppm) is the highest measured in this set. Still within FSSAI limits.

products.name: Chelated Magnesium Glycinate
products.notes: Single-ingredient chelate, also checked in a NanoHealth review. Price is the midpoint of ₹1,199–1,499 seen in Jun 2026, so verify it live.

products.name: Magnesium Glycinate
products.notes: Cleanest small-brand result, but the rating lapsed in Apr 2025.

products.name: Chelated Magnesium Glycinate
products.notes: Scores confirmed (label accuracy 10, non-toxicity 10). Raw lab values are on the Unbox Health product page (free login).

products.name: Magnesium Bisglycinate Powder
products.notes: Powder claiming 440 mg per serving, which is a high dose. Rating expired; raw values are on the Unbox Health page (free login).

products.name: CreaMag Boost (creatine + magnesium)
products.notes: Different category: 75 g creatine + 3.25 g magnesium bisglycinate per 100 g. Not a like-for-like comparison.

products.name: Chelated Magnesium Glycinate
products.notes: Included for reference as the only B-rated glycinate in the set. Raw values are on the Unbox Health page (free login).
